steps.title: Project Initialization
steps.description: Configure metadata for the School Companion app, defining the application name and base package structure to ensure clean environment setup.

steps.title: Gradle Build Configuration
steps.description: Setup app/build.gradle to target Android SDK 34, run on Java 17 toolchain, and configure Android Gradle Plugin 8.3.2 without third-party dependencies.

steps.title: Manifest and Security Setup
steps.description: Define AndroidManifest.xml containing application configuration, launching activity, and theme attributes targeting the built-in Material theme.

steps.title: UI Dashboard Layout Design
steps.description: Create activity_main.xml layout employing a modern tab-less navigation design using pure Android Views, allowing seamless switching between Schedule, Tasks, GPA, and Notes.

steps.title: Main Activity Shell Setup
steps.description: Create MainActivity.java file with standard lifecycle callbacks, initialization routines, and view referencing structures.

steps.title: Navigation Controller Implementation
steps.description: Develop navigation engine using vanilla Android Buttons and View visibility states to manage application tabs dynamically without heavy view-pager libraries.

steps.title: Schedule Manager Implementation
steps.description: Build the Class Schedule system supporting dynamic class addition, displaying schedules by weekday, and locally caching items using Android SharedPreferences and built-in JSON parsing.

steps.title: Assignment Task Tracker
steps.description: Implement Task/Assignment tracker letting users add, complete, and delete assignments dynamically. Handled inside SharedPreferences for robust offline data persistence.

steps.title: GPA Calculator Engine
steps.description: Build dynamic GPA calculator tab allowing users to add course names, letter grades, and credits, converting them immediately to standard 4.0 GPA points programmatically.

steps.title: School Notepad Feature
steps.description: Incorporate class notes module enabling prompt creation, storage, and retrieval of multi-line class notes to prevent losing vital school information.

steps.title: Java 8 Quality and Compatibility Audit
steps.description: Verify code strictly employs anonymous inner classes and standard collections, omitting any Java 9+ features or lambda expressions to ensure 100% build compatibility.

steps.title: Building School Companion
steps.description: Initiate compilation, assemble resources, compile layout files, process source code, and package the executable Android Application Package (APK).
